messages.text: Brief: walking clubs book eight to twenty beds at a time by phone. Let a group leader book several beds online in one booking.
Plan: a group booking with a leader, a bed count and one payment. The warden's arrivals list shows the group. Tests for a group larger than the free beds and a partial cancellation.
Under the leader's name, but the warden needs every guest's name before arrival for the mountain rescue list.
Three days before arrival. If they're missing, remind the leader. Never cancel a group for it.
Yes, one line with the leader's name and the head count.
Delivered: PR #301 merged. Leaders book a group in one go; names are due three days before with one reminder; the warden's list shows a single line when names are missing.

questions.text: Should a group booking hold beds under the leader's name only, or ask for every guest's name?
Then when are guest names due, and what happens if the leader has not sent them by then?
If names are still missing on arrival day, should the warden's list show the group as one line with the head count?

findings.title: Partial cancellation refunds the whole group
Reminder is sent again every day after it is due

dispositions.reason: Refunds only the cancelled beds; test added.

tasks.title: Close huts for the winter season

messages.text: Brief: most huts close for winter from mid-November. Bookings should stop for closed dates, per hut.
Plan: a season per hut with open and closed dates; the booking calendar greys out closed dates and the search skips closed huts. Tests for a booking that spans the closing date.
From the operator's chat yesterday: no bookings at all, except each hut's winter room.
First come first served, as now. Show it on the hut page but don't make it bookable.
Delivered: PR #303 merged. Closed dates are greyed out per hut; winter rooms show on the hut page as first come first served.

questions.text: Does 'closed for winter' mean no bookings at all, or only no catering?
Should the winter room be bookable online, or stay first come first served?

findings.title: A booking that spans the closing date is accepted

dispositions.reason: Rejected with the closing date named.

tasks.title: Show each hut's dog policy at booking

messages.text: Brief: guests keep turning up with dogs. Show each hut's dog rule when booking.
Plan: a dog rule per hut shown on the hut page and in the booking confirmation. I need the rule itself: the huts' notes disagree.
No dogs in dormitories anywhere. Private rooms at Corrie and High Fell allow one dog for a cleaning fee; everywhere else no dogs inside.
Thanks. Building it that way, with the cleaning fee added at booking.
Delivered: PR #305 merged. Each hut shows its dog rule; two huts' private rooms take one dog with a cleaning fee.

questions.text: The hut notes disagree on dogs: two say dogs are welcome everywhere, the rest say no dogs inside. What is the rule for dormitories and private rooms?

events.question: Hut notes disagree on dogs in dormitories and private rooms. What should the dog rule be?

tasks.title: Take a deposit instead of full payment

messages.text: Brief: guests should pay a 30 percent deposit at booking and the rest two weeks before arrival.

Plan: deposit at booking, the balance charged automatically fourteen days before arrival with a reminder three days earlier. Bookings within fourteen days pay in full. Tests for each path and a failed balance charge.
Delivered: PR #307 merged. Deposits at booking, balance fourteen days before, failed charges flagged and retried safely.

findings.title: A failed balance charge leaves the booking confirmed with nothing flagged
Deposit is rounded down, losing a cent on odd totals

dispositions.reason: Failed charges flag the booking for the warden and email the guest.

findings.title: Retrying a failed balance charge can charge twice
Warden flag does not clear after the guest pays by phone

dispositions.reason: Retry uses the same payment intent.
Clears when the balance is recorded.

tasks.title: Mountain weather warning on hut pages

messages.text: Brief: when the national weather service issues a mountain warning for a hut's area, show a banner on that hut's page.
Plan: read the warnings feed hourly, match warning areas to huts, and show a banner with the warning's text and a link to the service's page. Test with a recorded feed.
The changes review failed before it produced anything; requesting it again.
Delivered: PR #309 merged. Hut pages show the current mountain weather warning for their area.

findings.title: Banner stays after the warning expires

dispositions.reason: Banner uses the warning's end time.

messages.text: Brief: wardens should be able to post a short note about the approach path's conditions, shown on the hut page.
Plan: a conditions note per hut, posted by its warden, with the date it was written. Notes older than a week fade with 'last updated'. Tests for the fade.
Picked up again after the overnight session limit. Continuing with the note form.
Delivered: PR #313 merged. Wardens post a dated conditions note shown on the hut page; old notes fade.

events.reason: The engine's session limit was reached overnight; the task resumed after the limit reset in the morning.

messages.text: Brief: wardens assign bunks on paper each evening. Assign them automatically, keeping groups together and putting early leavers near the door.
This changes how every warden works. Don't merge it until I've shown it at the wardens' meeting on Thursday.
Understood: I will hold the merge until after Thursday's meeting.
Plan: allocate bunks per room after the day's bookings close, groups together, early departures nearest the door, and let the warden drag guests between bunks. Tests for a group bigger than a room.
Held as planned. Thursday.
The wardens liked it. Go ahead and merge.

questions.text: PR #311 is green and reviewed. Do you want it merged before Thursday after all, or held as planned?

messages.text: Brief: wardens print the day's arrivals. Give them a clean printable sheet.

messages.text: Brief: searching availability across all huts takes several seconds. Make it fast.
Plan: precompute free beds per hut per night when bookings change instead of counting at search time. Test that the counts match a full recount.
